keys.meta_title: Love Language Test: Free Quiz With a Score for All Five | CoreSkillAI
keys.meta_desc: Free love language test. Rate 25 statements and get a score for words of affirmation, quality time, gifts, acts of service and physical touch, plus tips for your partner. About 3 minutes.
keys.lov_desc: Score all five love languages, see your strongest ones and get tips to share with a partner.
keys.lov_how1: 25 short statements about feeling loved by a partner. Rate how true each one is for you.
keys.lov_how2: If you are single, think of a past partner or how you would like to be treated. There are no right or wrong answers.
keys.lov_how3: You get a score for all five love languages, your strongest ones and tips to share with a partner. Takes about 3 minutes.
keys.lov_start_desc: Find out which ways of being loved matter most to you, with a score for each of the five love languages.
keys.lov_balanced: Your five scores are close together. You value several ways of being loved about equally, which research suggests is common - most people appreciate all five.
keys.lov_shared: Your top languages are within a few points of each other, so treat them as joint favourites rather than a single winner.
keys.lov_disclaimer: Love languages are a popular idea, not a clinical measure, and research on them is still limited. This test is not affiliated with The 5 Love Languages®, a registered trademark of The Moody Bible Institute of Chicago.
keys.lov_q1: I feel loved when my partner tells me they appreciate me.
keys.lov_q2: I feel loved when my partner gives me their full attention.
keys.lov_q3: A thoughtful gift, even a small one, makes me feel loved.
keys.lov_q4: I feel loved when my partner helps with chores without being asked.
keys.lov_q5: I feel loved when my partner holds my hand or hugs me.
keys.lov_q6: I treasure time alone together without phones or other distractions.
keys.lov_q7: Hearing a sincere compliment from my partner means a lot to me.
keys.lov_q8: A touch on my arm or back makes me feel connected to my partner.
keys.lov_q9: I keep small presents and souvenirs my partner has given me.
keys.lov_q10: When my partner takes a task off my plate, I feel cared for.
keys.lov_q11: A kind note or message from my partner can make my day.
keys.lov_q12: I feel loved when my partner brings me something that shows they were thinking of me.
keys.lov_q13: Long, unhurried conversations make me feel close to my partner.
keys.lov_q14: Sitting close together matters to me.
keys.lov_q15: Practical help when I am busy or tired means more to me than words.
keys.lov_q16: A forgotten birthday or anniversary would hurt me.
keys.lov_q17: I feel distant when we go a long time without physical affection.
keys.lov_q18: Being praised for my efforts makes me feel valued.
keys.lov_q19: I feel let down when my partner promises to help and does not follow through.
keys.lov_q20: Doing things together matters more to me than what we actually do.
keys.lov_q21: I feel loved when my partner fixes or handles something for me.
keys.lov_q22: I feel hurt when my partner is distracted while we are spending time together.
keys.lov_q23: A hug is the best comfort when I am upset.
keys.lov_q24: Harsh or critical words from my partner hurt me deeply.
keys.lov_q25: The thought behind a gift means a lot to me.
keys.lov_dW: Spoken and written appreciation, encouragement and "I love you" make you feel valued.
keys.lov_dT: Undivided attention and time spent together make you feel close.
keys.lov_dG: Thoughtful presents, big or small, show you that you were on someone's mind.
keys.lov_dS: Practical help and having things taken care of make you feel supported.
keys.lov_dP: Hugs, holding hands and closeness make you feel connected and safe.
keys.lov_tipW: For a partner: say what you appreciate, out loud or in a message, and be specific.
keys.lov_tipT: For a partner: put the phone away and plan regular time that is just for the two of you.
keys.lov_tipG: For a partner: small, personal surprises count more than price. Remember the dates that matter.
keys.lov_tipS: For a partner: notice what is weighing on them and take one task off their list without being asked.
keys.lov_tipP: For a partner: offer everyday touch - a hug hello, holding hands, sitting close.
